purpose: Machine-readable, blocking acceptance fixtures derived from reviewed operating feedback. A fixture prevents VERIFIED promotion; it never changes business data or chooses an intervention.

cases.title: TX Dashboard metric integrity — Price's validation fixture
cases.promotion_rule: No dashboard card, lead or account diagnosis touching a listed target may be marked VERIFIED while a blocking finding fails.

findings.requirement: Observed Koronet BUY must not be labelled estimated BUY potential.
findings.acceptance_test: Potential has method, inputs, date and confidence; otherwise observed BUY is separately named and windowed.

findings.requirement: Online BUY percentage must expose its period, denominator and as-of date.
findings.acceptance_test: A reviewer can distinguish current-month, prior-quarter and YTD values without calculating or guessing.

findings.requirement: LIST must not conflate listing, inventory, sales-recency or coverage; online/offline comparison needs one definition.
findings.acceptance_test: The rendered metric carries a definition and compatible online/offline coverage, or is explicitly unavailable/proxy.

findings.requirement: Online/offline buyer counts and sell GMV must use the same source population and window.
findings.acceptance_test: Counts reconcile to total and no online-buyer claim is shown beside $0 online sell GMV without an explicit compatible explanation.

findings.requirement: Reimplementation and pre-existing individual-ecommerce purchasing are source-backed context, not automatic Procurement attribution.
findings.acceptance_test: The account narrative cites dated evidence or says context is not yet verified.

findings.requirement: BUY coverage can identify vendor/category/variety/SKU gaps and recurring online-to-offline leakage, or explicitly asks for the missing investigation.
findings.acceptance_test: No coverage card implies that a small offline vendor count explains offline GMV without compatible volume and transition evidence.
